```{r Combined Plot}
# Combined Plot
all_tests <- list(
  All = Species_dNdS_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests,
  Mutated = Species_dNdS_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly,
  All_Synonymous = Species_dNdS_Synonymous_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests,
  Mutated_Synonymous = Species_dNdS_Synonymous_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests_MutatedOnly,
  TtoA_AtoT = Species_dNdS_TtoA_or_AtoT_Rate_Spearman_Tests,
  CtoG_GtoC = Species_dNdS_CtoG_or_GtoC_Rate_Spearman_Tests,
  CtoT_GtoA = Species_dNdS_CtoT_or_GtoA_Rate_Spearman_Tests,
  CtoA_GtoT = Species_dNdS_CtoA_or_GtoT_Rate_Spearman_Tests,
  TtoG_AtoC = Species_dNdS_TtoG_or_AtoC_Rate_Spearman_Tests,
  TtoC_AtoG = Species_dNdS_TtoC_or_AtoG_Rate_Spearman_Tests
)

df <- map_df(names(all_tests), function(mutation_type) {

  # each object is a list of 7 htests
  tests <- all_tests[[mutation_type]]

  map_df(names(tests), function(species) {
    res <- tests[[species]]  # an htest object
    tibble(
      MutationType = mutation_type,
      Species = species,
      Rho = unname(res$estimate),
      Pvalue = res$p.value
    )
  })
})


#df <- subset(df, Species %ni% c("denovoDB_XXXX_Trio_Hsapiens_hg38",
#                                "Franciolo_2015_Trio_Hsapiens_hg38"))

#df$Species <- factor(df$Species, 
#                     levels = c("Assaf_2017_MA_Dmelanogaster_BDGP6",
#                                "SaxenaKonrad_2019_MA_Celegans_WS235",
#                                "Sarkies_2025_Em_Celegans_WS235",
#                                "Weller_2014_MA_Ppacificus_Elpaco",
#                                "Wang_2026_MA_Ppacificus_Elpaco",
#                                "Behringer_2016_MA_Spombe_ASM294v2",
#                                "Goldmann_2016_Trio_Hsapiens_hg38",
#                                "Villalbadelapena_2023_MA_Ncrassa_NC12"))

df$MutationType <- factor(df$MutationType, 
                          levels = c("All",
                                     "Mutated",
                                     "All_Synonymous",
                                     "Mutated_Synonymous",
                                     "TtoA_AtoT",
                                     "TtoG_AtoC",
                                     "TtoC_AtoG",
                                     "CtoG_GtoC",
                                     "CtoT_GtoA",
                                     "CtoA_GtoT"))

df$Signif <- df$Pvalue < 0.01

test <-
ggplot(df, aes(x = Species, y = Rho, fill = MutationType, group = MutationType)) +
  geom_col(
  linewidth = 3,
  aes(colour = as.character(Pvalue > 0.01),    # TRUE -> white outline, FALSE -> black outline
      alpha  = Pvalue < 0.01),                  # keep your alpha mapping
  position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5, preserve = "single"),
  width = 0.2
) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Spearman Correlations of dN/dS vs Mutation Rates",
    y = "Spearman Rho [Mutation Rate vs dNdS]",
    x = "Species"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black")  +
   theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # Subtle grid
        panel.grid.major.y     = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
        panel.grid.minor.y     = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.grid.major.x     = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
        panel.grid.minor.x     = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 6, colour = "white", hjust = .5),
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "white", size = 28, margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 3, color = "white", vjust = .6, angle = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, color = "white", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 70, color = "white", vjust = 0),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 50, color = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.key.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
    #strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eeeeee", colour = "white"),  # transparent panel, black border
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(4, "lines"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA)         # transparent overall background
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 20) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black",
                               "grey",
                               "#333333",
                               "#eeeeee",
                               "#B21801",
                               "red",
                               "#ff5800",
                               "#FFB703",
                               "#c8ff00",
                               "#66ff00",
                               "#008000")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("black",
                               "grey",
                               "#333333",
                               "#eeeeee",
                               "#B21801",
                               "red",
                               "#ff5800",
                               "#FFB703",
                               "#c8ff00",
                               "#66ff00",
                               "#008000")) +
  guides(colour = "none",
         fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top"),
         alpha = guide_legend(title.position = "top")) +
  facet_grid(~Species, scales = "free_x", space = "free")

# Save the plot — change width/height as needed
      ggsave(plot = test,
      filename = paste0(R_Data, "Plots/3_Mutation_and_dNdS_Association_Plots/",
                       "Species_Mutation_Category_vs_dNdS_Plot.png"),
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 40,
      height = 15,
      dpi = 800,
      device = ragg::agg_png)

```
